notes.title: Chinese language update!
notes.notes: Hello guys! Chinese language in Sovietpunk is available now! Thanks [url=https://twitter.com/aimonie]Aimonie[/url] for the good work!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hey!
Thank you for your support and feedback, it is very helpful and motivating. From the videos and reviews, the flaws of the game that have to be corrected became visible. I've added the map to help you understand where the player is in the dungeon. Before the continuation of the story, I plan to add some shooting mechanics and a few more features to add a little more variety to the gameplay.
See you at the Lower Level!
